item.title: 17-year-old driver killed in multi-vehicle SR 104 collision
item.description: A Poulsbo girl died in a multi-vehicle, head-on collision involving a Jefferson Transit Authority (JTA) bus outside Port Ludlow on March 3. item.title: Longtime utility commissioner dies at 92
item.description: Ken McMillen, a former, longtime Jefferson County Public Utility District (PUD) commissioner for District 2, died Feb. 27 at the age of 92. The PUD communications team shared the news March 9. item.title: Fighting fire
item.description: Will DeJarnett (left), and Wylder Browne (right), fight a controlled fire outside Northwest Maritime on March 6.
